points.description: States TRUE and justifies it by saying the parent and child are separate, independent processes, so the parent can call exec (or do any operation) without waiting for the child to terminate.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for TRUE with a vague justification, such as 'the parent can do anything' or 'exec is allowed in the parent', without saying the two processes are separate or independent.

rubric.notes: Full marks for TRUE plus a justification that the parent and child are different processes, so the parent can run exec itself without waiting for the child to end. Give 1 mark for TRUE with a weak or vague reason that still points toward the parent being free to act. Give 0 for FALSE, for TRUE with no justification, or for a justification that says the child must finish first or that the parent cannot exec.
